title: The Single English County Saying No to Palantir
description: The UK government is facing calls to cancel a sprawling health care contract with Palantir. The region of Greater Manchester insists it can do a better job itself.

title: Silicon Valley Doesn't Get Why You Hate AI
description: Technology leaders don’t seem to understand society’s gripes about AI, but boy, are they posting through it.

title: I Saw the Future of AI in a Robot That Can Learn on the Spot
description: During a recent visit to Generalist AI, I watched a robotic arm improvise and use a banana as a tool.

title: Coders Say They Already Found Workarounds to Claude’s Invisible Watermarks
description: Anthropic announced last week it would include invisible watermarks in AI-generated content to comply with new EU rules. Within hours, overrides were being touted online.

title: Flock Has a Powerful New AI Tool for Police. We Got Its Code
description: Flock’s surveillance cameras have already sparked outrage. WIRED reconstructed its next-generation AI system, already in use by some police, to confirm it goes much further than tracking license plates.

title: OpenAI Overhauls Safety Protocols After Its AI Agents Went Rogue
description: The ChatGPT maker says its upcoming Astra model may have reached “critical” cyber capabilities, prompting it to halt a significant number of training runs while it tightens internal safeguards.

title: The Powerful Chinese AI Model Experts Warned About Is Here
description: Z.ai’s latest AI model release could help companies secure their systems—or find its way into the hands of hackers.

title: Amazon Can Use Your Twitch Content to Train Its AI—Unless You Opt Out
description: When Twitch announced that streamers could opt out, thousands of users questioned why their content was being used to train AI models in the first place.

title: The Next Big Influencer Is This 4-Foot-Tall Robot From China
description: The Unitree G1 has found online fame as a relatively affordable robot that can charm a crowd. But can it ever hold down a real job?

title: Tech Visionary Says the Big AI Labs Don’t Get What People Want
description: Tim O’Reilly built a publishing empire that AI is helping to destroy. Yet he loves AI—as long as it’s open source.
